operator_actions: Create/import the GitHub repo in Vercel (framework: Next.js — auto-detected).
Provision Postgres (Vercel Postgres/Neon/Supabase) and set DATABASE_URL in Vercel Environment Variables (Production scope).

Set the remaining Production env vars: ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD (long random), ADMIN_SESSION_SECRET (openssl rand -hex 32), CREDENTIAL_PEPPER (recommended), GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, any future secrets.
Deploy the main branch (vercel --prod or Git integration).
One-time: run `DATABASE_URL=... npm run db:init` against the production database (applies 001 + 002, idempotent).
Open https://<production-domain>/admin and sign in with the admin env credentials.
In Secrets tab: verify GEMINI_API_KEY/GROQ_API_KEY show CONFIGURED (register metadata for any new secrets).
In Capabilities tab: confirm built-ins; optionally create ai.generate (gemini/generateText/GEMINI_API_KEY).
Create app MAHOLLA (dashboard or `npm run seed`), grant gemini.generate/ai.generate with limits; store the shown-once credential securely.
Configure Maholla with the Kryptos production URL + its credential (never in the APK binary).
Run production smoke tests: /api/health, execute round-trip, 401/403/429 behavior.
